pairs: do not let me be brought to ruin forever.
Esto mihi in Deum protectorem, et in locum munitum,
Be a God of protection and a place of strength for me,
ut salvum me facias: quoniam firmamentum meum et refugium meum es tu.
so that you may accomplish my salvation. For you are my firmament and my refuge.
et de manu contra legem agentis,
from the hand of the sinner,
and from the hand of the unjust and those who act against the law.
my hope from my youth, O Lord.
In te confirmatus sum ex utero;
In you, I have been confirmed from conception.
de ventre matris meæ tu es protector meus;
From my mother’s womb, you are my protector.
In you, I will sing forever.
I have become to many as if I were a portent,
but you are a strong helper.
Let my mouth be filled with praise,
so that I may sing your glory,
Ne projicias me in tempore senectutis;
Do not cast me off in the time of old age.
cum defecerit virtus mea, ne derelinquas me.
Do not abandon me when my strength will fail.
For my enemies have spoken against me.
et qui custodiebant animam meam consilium fecerunt in unum,
And those who watched for my soul have taken counsel as one,
For there is no one to rescue him.”
do not be far from me.
Confundantur et deficiant detrahentes animæ meæ;
May they be confounded, and may they fail, who drag down my soul.
operiantur confusione et pudore qui quærunt mala mihi.
Let them be covered with confusion and shame, who seek evils for me.
But I will always have hope.
et adjiciam super omnem laudem tuam.
And I will add more to all your praise.
My mouth will announce your justice,
For I have not known letters.
I will enter into the powers of the Lord.
I will be mindful of your justice alone,
You have taught me from my youth,
et usque nunc pronuntiabo mirabilia tua.
And so I will declare your wonders continuously,
Et usque in senectam et senium,
even in old age and with grey hairs.
donec annuntiem brachium tuum generationi omni quæ ventura est,
while I announce your arm to every future generation:
usque in altissima; quæ fecisti magnalia,
even to the highest great things that you have done.
Quantas ostendisti mihi tribulationes multas et malas!
How great is the tribulation that you have revealed to me: very great and evil. And so,
turning back, you have brought me to life,
et de abyssis terræ iterum reduxisti me.
and you have led me back again from the abyss of the earth.
You have multiplied your magnificence. And so,
turning back to me, you have consoled me.
Nam et ego confitebor tibi in vasis psalmi veritatem tuam,
Therefore, I will confess your truth to you, with the instruments of the Psalter.
I will sing psalms to you with stringed instruments,
Exsultabunt labia mea cum cantavero tibi;
My lips will exult, when I sing to you,
and also my soul, which you have redeemed.
Sed et lingua mea tota die meditabitur justitiam tuam,
And even my tongue will meditate on your justice all day long,
cum confusi et reveriti fuerint qui quærunt mala mihi.
when those who seek evils for me have been confounded and set in awe.
